dana: Weekend parlay pot? $5 to enter. Winner gets the taco truck for lunch + corner office for a day. 3-leg parlay: (1) Sat NFL winner, (2) Sun O/U, (3) Sat MLS match winner. DM Venmo @dana to pay. Who's in? :money_with_wings:
omar: In. $5 — but can we have a $2 casual tier for people who just want a flavor without the glory? :grimacing:
jen: In $5. Also yes to taco truck. pls no cilantro on mine :pleading_face:
sam: I can book the taco truck if we hit 10 people. I call first taco order. :taco:
lisa: I'm in $5. No trades, picks locked before kickoff, right? :thinking_face:
dana: Correct — no trades, picks locked 5 minutes before first kickoff. Post picks in thread or DM me if you want privacy. We only need 10 people to guarantee taco truck.
payments-bot: payments-bot: dana paid $5 -> pool $5 (1/10)
omar: Paid $5 to @dana (txn: venmo.com/dana/5). 2/10. Also proposal: 2nd place gets a pastry box? tiny consolation. :croissant:
jen: Paid. 3/10. pastry box for 2nd sounds good to me.
sam: Paid and I confirmed taco truck tentative hold for 12:45pm if we hit 10. 4/10.
lisa: Paid. Locked my picks: Chiefs, Under 52, NYRB. Good luck! :crossed_fingers: 5/10
dana: Quick picks update thread: share picks if you want to brag. We're halfway there.
omar: My picks: Pats, Over 48, LAFC. Locked at 12:10pm Sat. 6/10
mark: count me in — just paid. Mark: Chiefs, Over 50, Seattle. 7/10
kevin: paid $5 (via venmo) — sorry jumping in late. Picks: Bengals, Under 49, Columbus. 8/10
anya: Paid and in. Picks: Bills, Over 47, LAFC. 9/10
dana: ONE MORE and taco truck is on. @maria you coming? :eyes:
maria: ok fine, paid. Picks: Packers, Under 46, LAFC. LET'S GOOO :taco: 10/10
payments-bot: payments-bot: total entries 10 -> pool $50. Taco truck confirmed with Events for 12:45pm outside 4th floor. Corner office prize reserved for winner's choice of day this week.
jen: Great. Logistics note: if winner is remote, we'll do a $50 venmo and still order tacos for the office.
sam: I'll send taco order form later today. Please note dietary prefs in the form.
dana: Final housekeeping: picks must be in before 12:30pm kickoff. I'll lock thread and post bracket/payouts after games. Good luck everyone! :four_leaf_clover:
